headline: Visitor spending and arrivals increased to Maui in July 2026 | Maui Now
summary: July 2026 visitor counts on Maui reached 83.4% of pre-wildfire July 2023 levels, and year-to-date arrivals grew 7.7% versus 2025 but were 9.8% lower than before the wildfires.
why: Tourism is a core economic driver for Maui, and visitor spending supports hotels, retail and local employment. Recovery trends are watched as an indicator of the island's economic health.
